description: Translate docs/designs/ (2 files) and docs/plans/ February 2026 batch (~86 files). These are historical planning and design documents. The vast majority of plan files have a heavy Chinese prose body with English headings, fenced code blocks, and quoted English snippets. The translation policy is: translate the English narrative passages and all section headings; leave Chinese passages, code blocks, file paths, and identifiers untouched. Files with NO English prose (entirely Chinese) are skipped and recorded.
steps: Targets — docs/designs/2026-02-13-framework-v2-upgrade.md, docs/designs/2026-02-18-hook-architecture.md (2 files); and docs/plans/2026-02-*.md (86 files matching `docs/plans/2026-02-*`).

Iteration policy: process the files alphabetically. For each file, read it in full. Detect dominant language: if zero English sentences, mark as SKIPPED and append the path to `.agents/tasks/task-translate-md-ptbr/skipped-cn-plans.txt`. Otherwise translate.

Translation rules per file: (a) translate H1/H2/H3 headings — keep them concise, e.g. `# Framework v3: Deterministic Overhaul` → `# Framework v3: Reformulação Determinística`; `## Tasks` → `## Tarefas`; `## Phase 0: Deep Understanding` → `## Phase 0: Compreensão Profunda` (keep `Phase N` consecrated); `## Goal` → `## Objetivo`; `## Non-Goals` → `## Não-Objetivos`; `## Architecture` → `## Arquitetura`; `## Tech Stack` → `## Tech Stack` (consecrated); `## Affected Features` → `## Funcionalidades Afetadas`; `## Design Decisions` → `## Decisões de Design`; `## Checklist` stays; `## Review` stays. (b) translate plain English prose paragraphs; (c) translate the bold-label list items like `**Goal:**`, `**Non-Goals:**`, `**Architecture:**`, `**Tech Stack:**`, `**Work Dir:**`, `**Files:**`, `**Step 1:**` — for the LABELS only, keeping the value verbatim if it is a path/identifier or translating it if it is prose. Example: `**Goal:** 重构 agent 框架...` → `**Objetivo:** 重构 agent 框架...` (label translated, Chinese value untouched). Example: `**Goal:** Add an independent evaluator agent ...` → `**Objetivo:** Adicionar um agente avaliador independente ...`. (d) PRESERVE: every fenced code block including bash examples, every JSON snippet, every Python snippet, every shell pipeline, every file path, every `git tag`/`git push` command, every URL, every plan slug filename, every `@command` reference, every variable name, every emoji. (e) Replace every em dash (—) found in translated lines with a hyphen (-), regular dash, or rephrase the sentence. Em dashes inside fenced code blocks or inside Chinese passages stay verbatim.
Special files in this batch worth flagging:
- docs/plans/findings.md — small file with TDD-checklist findings prose (English). Translate fully.
- docs/plans/progress.md — iteration log with English bullets. Translate fully but keep timestamps/file paths/'Status: done' literal verbatim.
- docs/plans/*.progress.md and *.findings.md (multiple) — same handling as the canonical findings.md / progress.md, scoped per plan.
- docs/designs/2026-02-13-framework-v2-upgrade.md — long, mixed CN+EN with extensive tables. Translate the EN passages; leave CN tables verbatim.

Operate in batches of 8-12 files per `git add` & `git commit` call to keep commit history reviewable. Suggested split: (a) docs/designs/ + plans 2026-02-14*; (b) plans 2026-02-15*; (c) plans 2026-02-16*; (d) plans 2026-02-17*; (e) plans 2026-02-18*; (f) plans 2026-02-19*; (g) plans 2026-02-20*; (h) plans 2026-02-21*; (i) plans 2026-02-22-26*. Each batch commit message: `docs(i18n): translate docs/plans <batch tag> to pt-BR (preserve code blocks and Chinese passages)`.

After every batch, run a quick sanity check: `git diff --stat HEAD~1 HEAD` shows only the expected files, and `git diff HEAD~1 HEAD -- docs/plans/<one file>.md | head -50` looks like a translation diff (Portuguese on the right side, English on the left), with no shifts in code blocks (look for absence of changes inside fenced regions).

After ALL batches commit, run `python3 -m pytest -q --ignore=tests/test_generate_configs.py --ignore=tests/test_debugging_skill.py --ignore=tests/ralph-loop/test_evaluator.py --ignore=tests/ralph-loop/test_pty_runner.py --ignore=tests/ralph-loop/test_ralph_loop.py 2>&1 | tail -3` and `bash tests/test-agents-template.sh 2>&1 | tail -1` to confirm baseline preservation.
Append the skip list to .agents/tasks/task-translate-md-ptbr/skipped-cn-plans.txt and commit it with the final batch.
acceptance_criteria: Every file under docs/designs/ and docs/plans/ matching 2026-02-* either (a) has a Portuguese-prose diff with all code blocks unchanged, or (b) is recorded in skipped-cn-plans.txt as fully-Chinese.
No fenced code block was modified inside any translated file (verified by extracting and diffing fenced regions before/after).
No em dashes (—) introduced in any translated line outside fenced code blocks.
Pytest and tests/test-agents-template.sh outputs match baseline.txt.
verification: for f in $(git diff --name-only main HEAD -- docs/designs/ docs/plans/2026-02-*.md); do diff <(awk '/^```/{p=1-p; print; next} p' "$f") <(git show main:"$f" 2>/dev/null | awk '/^```/{p=1-p; print; next} p') > /dev/null && echo OK || echo "CODE CHANGED: $f"; done | grep -c CHANGED  # expect 0
git diff main HEAD -- docs/designs/ docs/plans/2026-02-*.md | grep -E '^\+' | grep '—' | head  # expect empty (no em dashes added)
